## Plan

### Mechanics summary
- 321 HP `[GAME-EXTRACT]`.
- Moves `[GAME-EXTRACT]`:
  - Liquify Ground: applies a power and adds 6 cards to your piles
  - Thrash: 8×2 (twice in the cycle)
  - Lunging Bite: 28
  - Salivate: +2 Strength
- **Seen in game** `[OBS]` (v0.111.1, A10, the Player's win on 2026-11-19, 9 turns, recorded turn by turn in `runs/smoke/combat-trace-2026-11-19.jsonl`): the wiki's cycle and A8+ numbers are right: Liquify Ground on turn 1, then Thrash 9×2, Lunging Bite 31, Salivate +3 Strength, Thrash 9×2, repeating (seen as 10×2, 32, buff, 13×2, 13×2, 35, buff, 16×2 with the Strength added); 341 HP. **The Sandpit counter is a power on the boss** (`SANDPIT_POWER` in the boss's powers, not the player's): 4 after Liquify, +1 for each Frantic Escape played, and -1 at the end of each player turn, before the boss acts (the guide that said "end of every turn" was right). The Player kept it at 2 to 6 and finished with Powdered Demise (9 Demise) on a 2 HP boss, at 8 HP. Frantic Escape's rising cost was not visible in the trace (no card costs recorded yet).
- **Sandpit** `[GAME-EXTRACT]`: decrements each turn, and when removed it kills its target (you). Frantic Escape cards (the added cards) push it back `[COMMUNITY]`, corroborated by the game data: Frantic Escape is a 1-cost Status that increases a power already on the target, i.e. adds to the Sandpit counter `[GAME-EXTRACT]`.
- **Numbers** `[COMMUNITY]` (search summaries of selphie1999gaming, neonlightsmedia and gamerblurb guides, accessed 2026-11-19): Sandpit starts at 4; each Frantic Escape adds 1 and costs 1 more energy each time one is played; Liquify Ground adds 6 Frantic Escapes. Sandpit ticks down at the start of a turn and kills you when removed `[GAME-EXTRACT]`, so **end every turn with Sandpit at 2 or more**.
- **Cycle from the wiki** `[COMMUNITY]` (slaythespire.wiki.gg page, accessed 2026-11-19): Liquify Ground first (4 Sandpit per player; 6 Frantic Escape per player, 3 into the draw pile and 3 into the discard pile), then Thrash 8×2, Lunging Bite 28, Salivate +2 Strength, Thrash 8×2, repeating (A8+: HP 341, 9×2, 31, +3). Lizard Tail and Fairy in a Bottle do not stop Sandpit. Simulated (`tools/simulate_fight.py`): far too hard for the model's deck (eaten in most fights), so not calibrated; the planner now keeps a buffer of up to 4 Sandpit, playing Frantic Escape while it is cheap (in the simulator that cut the fights lost to Sandpit from 30 to 18 of 40).
- **Cycle: sources disagreed before the wiki.** The game data lists Liquify Ground, Thrash 8×2 twice, Lunging Bite 28 and Salivate (+2 Strength) `[GAME-EXTRACT]`; one guide (neonlightsmedia, March 2026) describes a repeating Strength buff, hit, heavier hit, Strength buff, and says Sandpit drops at the end of every turn `[COMMUNITY]`. Not simulated until the first fight shows the order.
- `tools/plan_turn.py` reads `SANDPIT_POWER` from the state and marks any plan that ends the turn at 1 or less as fatal; `tools/advise.py` prints the counter. Before the planner fix (2026-11-19) every Status was treated as unplayable, so the Agent would never have played Frantic Escape.

### Deck checklist
- **Countable checks** (`tools/deck_check.py`, tuned on the history 2026-11-19) `[PLAYER-DATA, weak]`: energy or draw cards at least 2 (play the Frantic Escape cards and still fight (plan; no data signal)).
- **A race against the Sandpit timer:** either kill 321 HP before it runs out, or spend energy on Frantic Escape cards to buy turns.
- **Energy** to pay for Frantic Escape and attack in the same turn.
- **Block 28 on Lunging Bite**, plus Strength after each Salivate.

### HP target on arrival
- Ironclad benchmark: median 31.5, p75 45.8. **Rest if HP is below about 42.** Fatal fights started lower (59% against 69%, all characters).

### First three turns
- Track the Sandpit counter every turn. Play Frantic Escape whenever the counter would hit zero before the boss dies.

### Potion plan
- Energy potions are worth the most here.

### What killed the Player here, and the counter
- Ironclad: 2 of 6 fatal (all characters: 6 of 34). Ironclad's median damage is higher than the all-character median (32 against 26). `[PLAYER-DATA]`
- Counter: watch the Sandpit timer, keep energy for Escape cards.
